text: Union Minister reviews Samruddhi Mahamarg: the 701 km Mumbai-Nagpur expressway in Maharashtra is fully open, 6-lane access controlled, built at Rs 55,000 crore.
Samruddhi Mahamarg Mumbai-Nagpur expressway: 701 km, 6-lane, Maharashtra. Project cost 55,335 crore. Operational.
Vadhavan Port near Palghar, Maharashtra, deep-water greenfield port, estimated Rs 76,200 crore. Construction under way, first phase expected 2029.
Cabinet note: Vadhavan deep-water port Maharashtra approved at Rs 76,220 crore, major port capacity 298 MTPA planned.
Heard Vadhavan port cost has gone up to Rs 1,10,000 crore, big foreign investor involved!!
Chennai-Bengaluru Expressway, 262 km, 4-lane access controlled, Tamil Nadu and Andhra Pradesh stretches under construction, Rs 17,900 crore, completion 2027.
Chennai Bengaluru Expressway Tamil Nadu section delayed by land acquisition; work 78% complete, completion pushed to 2028.
Western Dedicated Freight Corridor, 1,506 km double-line electrified freight railway across Gujarat and Maharashtra, Rs 38,000 crore, largely operational, JNPT terminal link pending.
Western DFC Gujarat Maharashtra freight railway: JNPT connectivity delayed, expected 2027.
Vizhinjam International Seaport, Kerala, deep-water transshipment port, Rs 7,700 crore, operational since 2025, phase 2 expansion under construction.
Vizhinjam port Kerala phase 2 expansion progressing, deep-water berths, cost Rs 10,000 crore.
Hyderabad-Vijayawada NH-65 six-laning, 231 km, Telangana and Andhra Pradesh, Rs 10,000 crore, under construction, completion 2028.
NH-65 Hyderabad Vijayawada six lane already finished in Telangana! cost Rs 3000 crore only.
Mopa airport Goa and NH-66 bypass connectivity, 4-lane road, 32 km, Rs 1,200 crore, operational.
Visakhapatnam-Raipur economic corridor Andhra Pradesh, 464 km access controlled expressway, Rs 16,000 crore, construction under way, completion 2028.
Bhopal-Jabalpur four-lane NH upgrade in Madhya Pradesh, 295 km, Rs 7,800 crore, under construction, completion 2027.
Madhya Pradesh Indore-Bhopal rail double line electrified, 195 km, Rs 4,100 crore, operational.
Hyderabad Regional Ring Road northern part, 158 km, 4-lane access controlled, Telangana, Rs 17,000 crore, planned, land acquisition started.
Secret new port in Gujarat being built by foreign firm near Kutch, 500 acre, no details!!
Mumbai Pune Expressway missing link, 13 km tunnels and bridges, Maharashtra, Rs 6,300 crore, completion 2026 under construction.
